verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is the Private Cloud deployment, described as a dedicated managed service providing "dev instances" and an isolated environment. That suggests non-production instances exist, but only within an enterprise Private Cloud offering and in a single thin mention. Missing for 10: documented sandbox/dev tenant support on standard plans, guidance on keeping test data separate from production, a sandbox workflow for AI agents (e.g., MCP/CLI targeting a test tenant), and independent corroboration.
